EPISODE_NARRATIVE: A weak cold front moved into a very unstable air mass and triggered isolated severe thunderstorms in southeastern Massachusetts in the later afternoon and early evening. Torrential downpours led to some urban flash flooding as well.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: In Attleboro, Forest Street at Field Road by flooded and impassable for a time.

EPISODE_NARRATIVE: A weak cold front moved into a very unstable air mass and triggered isolated severe thunderstorms in southeastern Massachusetts in the later afternoon and early evening. Torrential downpours led to some urban flash flooding as well.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: In New Bedford, urban flash flooding occurred.  At 521 PM EST, Sawyer Street was flooded.  Then, at 530 PM EST, Summer Street was closed due to three feet of water on the road.  Also, the Route 18 exit ramp to Purchase Street was flooded and impassable.
